{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Potato|Potato]]
__NOTOC__
==Ingredients==
*4 medium/fair sized potatoes (Russets are preferable)
*4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] of [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] or ([[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola oil]])
*5 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] sea [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] ([[Cookbook:paprika|paprika]] or onion salt works too)
*4 grams of [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]] or [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]] (many seasonings can work)

==Procedure== 
#Slice potatoes evenly (over-sized wedges can result in uneven cooking).
#Sprinkle seasoning and salt over each potato.
#[[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|Deep fry]] potato wedges until brown and crispy (cook longer for more crispiness.)
#Put in a plastic container and put in fridge (or just put on a cooling area if eating immediately).
